name: Yu-Gi-Oh! Arc-V
description: Yuya Sakaki's dream is to follow in his father's footsteps and become the greatest "duel-tainer" in history - and he just might pull it off when he suddenly discovers Pendulum Summoning, a never-before-seen technique that lets him summon many monsters at once!

videos.title: Swing Into Action (1)
videos.overview: Swing into action with the dueltainer Yuya Sakaki as he takes center stage in an all-new Action Duel where running, jumping, diving and dueling can make you a champion!

videos.title: Swing Into Action (2)
videos.overview: With The Sledgehammer set to strike, Yuya uses Pendulum power to swing the duel his way! Can this phenomenal new summoning method help Yuya hammer the Hammer?

videos.title: You Show 'Em
videos.overview: Zuzu faces a fusion summoner with tough jewel monsters.

videos.title: A Date with Fate (1)
videos.overview: Yuya’s future takes a terrifying turn for the worse when he battles a fortunetelling foe who predicts this will be his last duel ever! Can Yuya fix his fate and avoid a devastating disaster, or has his luck finally run out?

videos.title: Dragon's Vengeance
videos.overview: Yuya’s new dragon attacks the Obelisk Force mercilessly. Then, as if he was possessed by something, Yuya continues on his rampage despite having defeated the enemies.
